blocks.text: A 25-year-old man was arrested on Saturday for allegedly throwing his two daughters off the balcony of his sixth-floor apartment in Gifu Prefecture, central Japan, police said. The police had already been called to the site by the man’s wife, who made an emergency call late Friday night saying her husband was acting violently. They were able to ready mats to cushion the fall of the two daughters, a 4-year-old and 1-year-old.
